headline: Google announces Pixel 11 pre-orders will include a mandatory subscription to a virtual AI therapist
body:
The tech giant confirmed that all pre-orders for the upcoming Pixel 11 series will come pre-installed with 'Sensei-Droid,' a mandatory AI integration designed to provide 24/7 psychological validation for users who accidentally touch their own camera bumps.

'We noticed our users were suffering from existential dread whenever they looked at the phone’s back panel, so we decided to provide immediate, automated comfort,' said a senior product manager at the company’s hardware division. 'The AI doesn't just process photos; it tracks your eye movements to detect micro-expressions of disappointment and immediately plays a soothing playlist of ambient rain sounds while whispering that your battery life is actually quite sufficient.'

Existing users who have already placed their pre-orders are being given the option to upgrade to the 'Deep Existential Mode,' which requires the phone to be stored in a silk-lined box for eight hours a day to 'meditate on its own hardware limitations.' The company expects this to bridge the gap between human anxiety and consumer electronics hardware, ensuring that every smartphone owner feels truly understood by a piece of silicon.
caption: Pixel 11 buyers are now required to let their phones psychoanalyze them during every charging cycle. Your phone knows you’re stressed, and it’s finally ready to talk about it. #GooglePixel #TechNews #AI #Smartphones (satire)
